save.title: Record title

save.errFallback: The record could not be saved.

record.notFound: The record was not found, or you do not have access to it.
record.loadFailed: The record could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

saved.updateFailed: The update could not be made; try again.
saved.frozen: This chart is the calculation made at the time of saving; it does not change even if the calculation engine is updated.
saved.clientMissing: The linked client can no longer be accessed (it may have been deleted). The record is kept.
saved.addQuestion: Add the saved question text to the report
